description: Angular component for managing widget actions in the Thingsboard UI, including features like adding, editing, deleting, drag-and-drop reordering, filtering, and pagination of widget actions.

classes.name: ManageWidgetActionsComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing widget actions, including UI interactions, data handling, and dialog operations.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes resize observer and sets up resize handling.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and marks component as destroyed.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up event subscriptions for search input, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Loads actions data based on current pagination and sorting state.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new widget action.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit an existing widget action.

methods.name: openWidgetActionDialog
methods.description: Opens dialog for creating or editing widget actions.

methods.name: saveAction
methods.description: Saves a new or updated widget action.

methods.name: getOrCreateTargetActions
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the list of actions for a given source.

methods.name: deleteAction
methods.description: Deletes a widget action after confirmation.

methods.name: enterFilterMode
methods.description: Enables text search mode and focuses input.

methods.name: exitFilterMode
methods.description: Disables text search mode and resets filter.

methods.name: resetSortAndFilter
methods.description: Resets sorting and filtering to default state.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers change callback for form control.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers touched callback for form control.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the component.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes actions data into the component.

methods.name: onActionsUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to actions and propagates changes.
